title: Plaqueboymax vs Zoe Spencer controversy explained as streamer responds to homophobic F-slurs
summary_full: Recent revelations of inappropriate Discord messages from Zoe Spencer aimed at Plaqueboymax have ignited discussions online. While some viewers critique or troll him, Plaqueboymax maintains his composure, asserting he won’t escalate the situation. This calm reaction has drawn mixed reactions, and notable creator Wardrobe has opted to unfollow Zoe amidst the ongoing controversy that continues to trend on social platforms.
